---
# all [bracketed] values are placeholders — fill in before publishing.
#   [course_title]     — page title and h1 heading
#   [course_tagline]   — one-sentence description shown below the title
#   [instructor_name]  — full name linked in the info block
#   [instructor_url]   — personal or faculty page url
#   [preferred_name]   — name students use in class
#   [meeting_times]    — e.g. "mondays, wednesdays, fridays from 10:00 to 10:50am"
#   [room]             — e.g. "bronfman 106"
#   [office_hours]     — e.g. "tuesdays and thursdays from 1:00 to 2:30pm"
#   [office_location]  — e.g. "adams 213"
#   [pset_policy]      — collaboration policy for problem sets
#   [quiz_policy]      — quiz format and cadence
#   [exam_policy]      — exam format and materials allowed
#   [project_policy]   — final project overview
#   [resources]        — textbook or course notes attribution
title: "**[COURSE_TITLE]**"
output:
  html_document:
    css: styles.css
---

<center>
*[COURSE_TAGLINE]*
</center>

<br>

<div class="row">
  <div class="col" markdown="1">

  **Instructor**: [[INSTRUCTOR_NAME]]([INSTRUCTOR_URL]). Please call me [PREFERRED_NAME].

  **Class Times**: [MEETING_TIMES] in [ROOM].

  **Office Hours**: [OFFICE_HOURS] in [OFFICE_LOCATION].

  **Problem Sets**: [PSET_POLICY]

  </div>
  <div class="col" markdown="1">

  **Quizzes**: [QUIZ_POLICY]

  **Exams**: [EXAM_POLICY]

  </div>
</div>

**Resources**: [RESOURCES]

    <td>Week</td>
    <td>Tuesday</td>

    <td colspan="5">[Unit 1 Title]</td>
  </tr>

  <!-- regular lecture week -->

    <td>Week 1 ([DATE] and [DATE])</td>

    <td><a href="slides/Week01.pdf">Slides</a></td>

  </tr>

  <!-- midterm week -->
  <tr>
    <td>Week N ([DATE] and [DATE])</td>
    <td><a href="notes/0N_[TOPIC].html">[Lecture Title]</a></td>
    <td><i>Midterm Exam</i></td>
    <td></td>
    <td></td>
  </tr>

  <!-- break week -->
  <tr>
    <td>Week N ([DATE] and [DATE])</td>
    <td><i>[Break Name] (No Class)</i></td>
    <td><i>[Break Name] (No Class)</i></td>
    <td></td>
    <td></td>
  </tr>

  <!-- unit divider — duplicate section as needed -->
  <tr class="section-header">
    <td colspan="5">[Unit 2 Title]</td>
  </tr>

  <!-- final week -->
  <tr>
    <td>Week N ([DATE] and [DATE])</td>
    <td><i>Project Preparation</i></td>
    <td><i>[Reading Day / Finals / etc.] (No Class)</i></td>
    <td></td>

  </tr>
